tldr:
For a fixed binary potential-outcome roster, the uniform treatment/control/unseen partition is the only source of randomness, and the target is its average causal effect. Two headline kernels evaluate the worst-table balanced difference-in-means atom. The all-face contraction is attained by the centered monotone continuous table and evaluated by a quadratic root and five entropy cells. On each declared off-center regular compact \(K\), the sharp envelope is
\[
M_{N,n}(q,t)=N^{-1/2}A(q,\beta,t)e^{-NJ(q,\beta,t)}\{1+o_K(1)\},
\]
uniformly over admitted lattice inputs, with an explicit positive, parity-independent determinant constant. Rounded centered monotone tables attain this equivalent; all attaining table sequences are characterized exactly. The complementary universal polynomial theorem covers census, support boundaries, parity and vanishing enrollment fractions. Inclusive tails and certified positive-tolerance inversion give a conservative connected interval with finite causal coverage. Exact likelihoods, existing exact intervals and generic entropy tools remain credited.
